headline: Red Sox stumble at home while the Patriots suffer brutal loss
morning_brew: I watched that loss against the Angels through my fingers like a horror movie and frankly it was a total disastah. Jake Bennett getting tagged for six runs in less than six innings put us in a hole we just could not climb out of, and leaving runners on base in key spots is killin' our momentum. We are fighting for our lives in this wild card race and nights like this are exactly what we cannot afford when the schedule is this damn tight.

The football side of things wasn't any better, with the Patriots dropping a heartbreaker in Seattle. Drake Maye threw three picks and the offense just could not find the end zone when it mattered most. To make matters worse, losing A.J. Brown for at least a month with a high ankle sprain is a massive blow to the passing game. It is a long season, but this is not the start we needed.

We have to turn the page immediately as the Royals come into Fenway for a series starting Friday night. The Duck Boat fund is feeling a bit light after yesterday's performance, but I am choosing to believe this team has one more run in them. My neighbor Rick is already claiming the Patriots' loss was due to some weird turf configuration in Seattle, which is classic Rick, but I will be tuned in to the Fens hoping for a win to get things back on track.

trend_watch.trend: Mickey Gasper went zero for four at the plate in the loss to the Angels.
trend_watch.dans_take: If Gasper is gonna be our DH, he needs to do better than a goose egg in the box score.

trend_watch.trend: Wyatt Olds tossed one and two thirds scoreless innings with one strikeout against the Angels.
trend_watch.dans_take: Olds actually gave us a chance to breathe, which is more than I can say for the rest of the night.

trend_watch.trend: Wilyer Abreu went one for three with a solo home run in the defeat.
trend_watch.dans_take: Abreu found the seats, but one solo shot isn't enough to carry this lineup when everything else is stagnant.

news_digest.headline: Source: Patriots' A.J. Brown likely out at least 4 weeks
news_digest.dans_take: Losing our top wideout for a month is an absolute nightmare that we just do not have the depth to handle.

news_digest.headline: MLB Power Rankings Week 24: AL contender rising in mid-September
news_digest.dans_take: Power rankings don't mean a damn thing when we are playing like this in September.
